page.layout: One page of text, single column, with Greek words printed in running text and a centred italic heading. Running head at top with page number at top right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Φύγω, fugabo, ἔφυξα, fugavi, non ἔφυγον: ἀλλύω, fugio, ἀλύω, fugiam, ἤλυξα, fugi: & similia.
main_text.head: Secundum indefinitum tempus.
main_text.p: ἐτυπόμψ, ἐτύπτλε, ἔτυπον, vel ἐτύπτασαν, Bœoticè.
main_text.head: Quomodo formatur secundum indefinitum tempus?
main_text.p: Si imperfecti augmentum præponatur secundo futuro, mutato ã in ον: ut, ἐτυπτλον, τυπῶ, ἐτυπον.
main_text.head: Tertium indefinitum tempus.
main_text.p: Εἴθε τύψαιμι, utinam verberaverim, τύψαις, τύψαι.
τυψεάμψ, τυψεάλε, τύψεαν. Formatur à primo indefinito.
main_text.head: Quartum indefinitum tempus.
main_text.p: Εἴθε τύπποιμι, utinam verberaverim, τύπποις, τύπποι.
τύπποιμψ, τύπποιλε, τύπποιεν. A secundo indefinito.
main_text.head: Quintum indefinitum tempus.
main_text.p: Ἐὰν τύψω, si verberaverim, τύψης, τύψη.

page.notes: The Greek forms are reproduced from the scan with limited certainty; the Greek accents and breathings, and the verb-stem letters in the paradigm lines (e.g. ἐτυπέτλω, ἐθέτλω, ἐςήτλω), are doubtful and may be misread. Lines of verb forms are set in small type with ligature-like Greek and are transcribed as the nearest legible reading. Some Greek forms in the pronoun-like paradigm cells could not be read with certainty and are marked only in their context. The heading "Quomodo formatur…" is set in italic and is treated as a level 2 heading.
